# XMarks: a searchable library for your X (Twitter) bookmarks

> XMarks is a free, open-source Chrome extension that turns your X bookmarks into a library you can search, sort into categories, tag and add notes to. Everything is stored in your browser. There is no XMarks account and no XMarks server.

## Key features
- **One-click sync**: Imports the bookmarks you already have from X (the Bookmarks page, or the Bookmarks tab in History). Pause and resume at any time; duplicates are skipped.
- **Save as you scroll**: Adds a save button to each post's action bar, or saves a copy whenever you use X's own bookmark button.
- **Search**: Searches post text, quoted posts, authors, tags and your notes.
- **Categories, tags and notes**: Color-coded categories, tags and private notes on every post.
- **Optional auto-categorize**: Sorts posts into your categories with a small embedding model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via Transformers.js). The model is downloaded once from Hugging Face when you turn the feature on, then runs in your browser. Your bookmark text is never sent anywhere.
- **Backup**: Export the whole library, or selected posts, to JSON and import it in another browser.

## Technical details
- **Platform**: Chrome and other Chromium browsers (Manifest V3)
- **Storage**: IndexedDB in the browser; settings in Chrome extension storage
- **License**: MIT
- **Repository**: https://github.com/YarooqH/xmarks
- **Privacy policy**: https://yarooqh.github.io/xmarks/privacy/
- **Terms of use**: https://yarooqh.github.io/xmarks/terms/
